# Love Doughs

> Bangladesh's first edible cookie dough tin brand. Scoopable, ribbon-tied cookie dough made in tiny batches in Dhaka.

## Brand
- Name: Love Doughs
- Website: https://lovedoughs.vercel.app
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/love.doughs/
- Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh (home kitchen / delivery-only)
- Positioning: First home-grown bakery in Bangladesh to serve edible cookie dough in circular gold tins tied with a red ribbon. No other bakery or restaurant in the country serves this.

## Products
- Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough Tin — 500g — ৳850 — dark chocolate chips, ganache drizzle, brown butter base. Safe to eat raw or bake.
- Red Velvet Cookie Dough Tin — 500g — ৳1000 — white chocolate chunks, cocoa red velvet, vanilla bean. Safe to eat raw or bake.

## How to order
Orders are placed via Instagram DM (@love.doughs). Use https://lovedoughs.vercel.app/order to compose the order, then send it on Instagram. Confirmation within about an hour. Payment: cash on delivery, bKash, or Nagad.

## Delivery
Delivered across Dhaka within 24 hours of baking. Areas include Gulshan, Banani, Dhanmondi, Bashundhara, Uttara, Mirpur, Mohakhali, and Lalmatia. Free delivery inside Dhaka on orders of 2+ tins.

## Safety
Heat-treated flour and egg-free base — safe to scoop and eat raw from the tin. Also bakeable at 180°C for ~8 minutes.
